name: DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.strictDecidePM_val
typeText:
∀ (g : DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance) (k : Nat),
  Eq.{1} (DisequalityDispersion.Costed.val (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.strictDecidePM g k))
    (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.strictDecideP g k)

source.code:
theorem strictDecidePM_val (k : ℕ) : (g.strictDecidePM k).val = g.strictDecideP k := by
  unfold strictDecidePM strictDecideP
  by_cases hk : 2 ≤ k
  · cases hv : g.isValid
    · simp [hk, hv, isValidGM_val]
    · cases ht : g.base.testsDistinct g.base.canonIds <;>
        simp [hk, hv, ht, isValidGM_val, canonIdsM_val, testsDistinctM_val, rhoFlowM_val]
  · simp [hk]

g : GInstance
k : ℕ
⊢ (g.strictDecidePM k).val = g.strictDecideP k

g : GInstance
k : ℕ
⊢ (do
        tick (natC 2 + natC k)
        if 2 ≤ k then do
            let v ← g.isValidGM
            if v = true then do
                let ids ← g.canonIdsM
                let d ← g.testsDistinctM ids
                if d = true then do
                    let r ← g.rhoFlowM ids
                    tick (natC k + natC (k + 1) + natC r)
                    Pure.pure (decide (k + 1 ≤ r))
                  else Pure.pure false
              else Pure.pure false
          else Pure.pure false).val =
    if 2 ≤ k then
      if g.isValid = true then
        have ids := g.base.canonIds;
        if g.base.testsDistinct ids = true then decide (k + 1 ≤ g.rhoFlowL ids) else false
      else false
    else false
